75096.meaning1: having repeatedly gone (to); having fallen (into) again

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, bhaggava, acelo pāthikaputto āyāmi āvuso, āyāmi āvuso'ti vatvā tatth'eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā'pi vuṭṭhātuṃ.

75099.commentary: (DNt) bhaṇitabbo vāro yassā'ti hi bhāṇavāro, ekena sajjhāyanamaggena kathetabbavāro'ti attho.

examples.text: bodhivaggo, mucalindavaggo, nandavaggo, meghiyavaggo, soṇavaggo, jacc'andhavaggo, cūḷavaggo, pāṭaligāmiyavaggo'ti vaggato aṭṭhavaggaṃ, suttato asītisuttasaṅgahaṃ, gāthāto pañcanavuti-udānagāthā-saṅgahaṃ. bhāṇavārato aḍḍh'ūnanavamattā bhāṇavārā.
